data structures and the notations that we would be following in the rest of this course.
We will begin with just some very simple definitions, an algorithm which is an outline
of the steps that a program has to take or any computational procedure has to take.
A program on the other hand is an implementation of an algorithm, it could be in any programming
language. A data structure is the way we need to organize the data so that it can be used
effectively by the program. So you all are familiar with certain data structures, an

structures in this course and you will see how to use them in various algorithms. So we
will take a particular problem try to solve that problem and in the process develop data
structures the best way of organizing the data associated with that problem.
